'''Gnome Restaurant''', known by the gnomes as '''Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service''', is a [[minigame]] that involves [[Gnome cooking]], and delivering your creations to various customers as quickly as possible. To start the minigame, talk to [[Gianne jnr.]] on the west end of the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Grand Tree]].

It is strongly recommended that you have completed [[The Grand Tree]] quest before playing this minigame.

Completing a delivery for the Gnome Restaurant is a requirement for the [[medium Western Provinces Diary]].
